integrity: Proof is analytical; the included Python standard-library tests are numerical corroboration only and are not independent certification.
scientific_limitations: The exact theorem concerns a unit Euclidean ball intersected with exactly one closed halfspace. It excludes the degenerate cut at the tangent plane, multiple nonparallel cuts, and non-Euclidean balls. A full text of the 2015 harmonic-mean measure paper was not inspected, and independent historical priority assessment remains outstanding.
title: Exact largest symmetric cores of clipped Euclidean balls
